tips: Prioritize Reels over static pictures and short text breaking posts, as Reels generate virtually all page views and high engagement.
Focus on high-impact Science/Tech, major IT/Business outages, and historic US political shifts, which produced the page's top-performing posts.
Use English for global tech and viral stories, while reserving Urdu for Pakistan-specific news and regional sports content.
Avoid plain text breaking updates and standard static image news regarding generic Americas and Middle East politics.
Publish major content strictly during peak hours between 12:00 UTC and 20:00 UTC, completely avoiding the dead zone from 04:00 to 09:00 UTC.

news.summary: Aap ke page par Reels format sab se zabardast perform kar raha hai, jab ke simple pictures aur breaking news format par views boht kam hain. Tech, major business outages aur US news par sab se zyada views aur engagement mili hai. Americas, Asia aur Middle East ke ordinary news topics flop ho rahe hain. Is liye humne Science/Tech aur US content ki frequency barha di hai aur posting schedule ko 12:00-20:00 UTC prime hours par set kiya hai.

tips: Prioritize Urdu language posts and video reels, as Urdu content significantly outperforms English in reach and engagement.
Focus heavily on combat sports and entertainment topics like Wrestling (WWE), Boxing, MMA, and Esports while reducing low-performing niche sports.

Create dramatic Urdu hooks for storytelling (e.g., historical moments, shocking decisions in WWE, heavyweight clashes) to boost view duration.
Avoid posting duplicate stories or repetitive generic updates (e.g., Golf PGA tour news or minor Rugby/Cycling announcements).
